## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a pale, petite individual. She has fine, silky, fawn-colored hair that flows over her shoulders in smooth ripples.

## History

Annetta Bell became a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after her parents moved their house fifty yards north into the district. When asked to turn in a composition assignment, she copied old love letters, leading her teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), to confront her about the infraction. Annetta continued her schooling under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually announced her resignation to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), +99 more_

## Quotes

> “I am Mrs. Donnell . . . Mrs. H. B. Donnell,” announced this vision, “and I have come in to see you about something Clarice Almira told me when she came home to dinner today. It annoyed me excessively.”
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

> "Clarice Almira told me that you pronounced our name Donnell. Now, Miss Shirley, the correct pronunciation of our name is Donnell . . . accent on the last syllable. I hope you’ll remember this in future."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)

> "“‘Dearest teacher, good night. The sun has set and the stars are shining . . . stars that are as bright and beautiful as your eyes. I kiss your hands and face, my sweet. May God watch over you and protect you from all harm."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P24](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0024)

> "And I do love you, teacher,’ she sobbed. ‘It was all true, even if the minister wrote it first. I do love you with all my heart."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P29](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0029)

> "Certainly it is. And Clarice Almira also informed me that you call my son Jacob."
>
> — Annetta Bell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017)
